A '''Molecularly agitated cheese sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] which contained [[molecularly agitated cheese]]. They were served with a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxdays]] as part of the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant's]] daily lunch and dinner [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] for 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Molecularly agitated cheese sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
